params.1273: Use gathering skills to claim sacred clay for your team, or combat skills to prevent your opponents doing the same.
params.1292: Gives points, which can be exchanged for experience-boosting equipment and armour.
params.1274: You may play this minigame as often as you wish.
params.1275: Talk to the Head Mystic in the Stealing Creation camp to learn more.
params.1276: You cannot bring any of your own items through the Stealing Creation portal.
params.1277: You can harvest better clay deposits with 20, 40, 60 and 80 levels in a skill.
